opening.argument: Forsage is presented as a path to becoming a millionaire in 100 days, then paired with a displayed 0.05 ETH joining payment and direct prompts to act. The participation screen calls it an “OPPORTUNITY,” while another frame directs viewers to the Forsage website for more information. Earnings figures on a phone appear alongside “DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME,” adding urgency to the pitch. Taken together, these observable claims and prompts promote participation in a rapid-wealth opportunity built around Forsage's tiered system. They support the conclusion that the video recruits viewers through promised commissions and participation tiers; they do not establish that anyone joined, earned money, or suffered a loss.

citations.quote: Forsage Blockchain Smart Contract: Door to Becoming a Millionaire in 100 Days.
